sub_strands.name: Sorting and Grouping
performance_indicators: Sort concrete objects based on two attributes simultaneously such as color and size.
Group items based on multiple attributes within the classroom.
Organize sorted play materials neatly in designated learning corners.

sub_strands.name: Matching and Pairing
performance_indicators: Pair up asymmetrical or complementary objects based on functional relations.
Match number symbols up to 9 with corresponding groups of pictorial objects.
Identify mismatched pairs of items within a collection.

sub_strands.name: Ordering and Patterns
performance_indicators: Arrange up to 5 items in sequence from shortest to longest or vice versa.
Create and extend simple multi-attribute patterns using concrete shapes.
Identify the missing element in a simple progressive or repeating pattern.

sub_strands.name: Counting
performance_indicators: Rote count numbers sequentially from 1 up to 50.
Count up to 20 concrete items using stable, precise one-to-one correspondence.
Count backwards from 10 to 1 during group math games and rhymes.

sub_strands.name: Number Recognition and Writing
performance_indicators: Identify and read abstract number symbols from 1 up to 20.
Write number symbols from 1 to 20 correctly following proper directional strokes.
Match number symbols with their equivalent representations in tally marks or pictures.

sub_strands.name: Number Value and Operations
performance_indicators: Represent number values up to 20 using bundles of sticks or counters.
Demonstrate the concept of addition as 'putting together' using objects up to a sum of 9.
Demonstrate the concept of subtraction as 'taking away' using objects up to 9.

sub_strands.name: Money
performance_indicators: Identify and distinguish current Kenyan currency coins (1, 5, 10, 20 shillings).
Simulate basic shopping experiences using artificial coin tokens during play.

sub_strands.name: Time and Mass
performance_indicators: Sequence daily school routines into morning, afternoon, and evening.
Compare the mass of objects using terms such as 'heavier than', 'lighter than', or 'same as' via hand balancing.

sub_strands.name: Auditory Discrimination
performance_indicators: Distinguish and identify letter sound blends and simple phonemes.
Recognize rhyming words in simple spoken sentences, poems, and chants.
Locate the direction of subtle sounds produced within the classroom layout.

sub_strands.name: Listening Comprehension
performance_indicators: Listen attentively to a short story and recall key events or characters.
Execute multi-step oral instructions delivered by an educator sequentially.
Answer simple contextual questions regarding a read-aloud session.

sub_strands.name: Vocabulary and Articulation
performance_indicators: Pronounce common words clearly and introduce new vocabulary into daily speech.
Use grammatically correct simple sentences to describe an immediate event.
Narrate a personal experience or tell a short story to peers confidently.

sub_strands.name: Social Communication
performance_indicators: Initiate conversations and respond appropriately to questions from peers.
Apply contextual courtesy phrases consistently during group work and play.
Maintain basic conversational focus during structural circle time.

sub_strands.name: Phonemic Awareness
performance_indicators: Associate lower-case and upper-case alphabet letters with their initial phonetic sounds.
Read simple two-letter and three-letter words (CVC words) phonetically.

sub_strands.name: Print Awareness
performance_indicators: Track text tracking fluidly from top-to-bottom and left-to-right across lines.
Recognize common sight words and simple environmental print symbols.

sub_strands.name: Pattern Writing and Tracing
performance_indicators: Develop consistent directional patterns (curves, zig-zags, straight lines) on unruled paper.
Trace letters, numbers, and geometric boundaries precisely within given outlines.

sub_strands.name: Independent Letter Formation
performance_indicators: Write lower-case letters of the alphabet legibly with balanced sizing.
Write their own first name clearly without copying from a template.

sub_strands.name: Weather Changes
performance_indicators: Record daily weather conditions onto a basic pictorial classroom weather chart.
Select appropriate clothing items corresponding to specific weather shifts.

sub_strands.name: Soil and Water Exploration
performance_indicators: Differentiate between dry soil and wet mud through tactile handling experiments.
Demonstrate basic properties of water, identifying floating and sinking objects.

sub_strands.name: My Family and Community
performance_indicators: Identify the roles and duties of different family members within a home set-up.
Name key community helpers and their professions (e.g., teachers, doctors, police officers).

sub_strands.name: Safe Neighborhood Navigation
performance_indicators: Recognize safe play spaces and identify potential danger spots in the neighborhood.
Adhere to simple road safety habits such as checking left and right before crossing.

sub_strands.name: Food and Nutrition
performance_indicators: Distinguish between healthy foods and unhealthy snacks in their regular diet.
Practice table manners and positive hygiene before consuming food.

sub_strands.name: Body Preservation
performance_indicators: Demonstrate proper techniques for brushing teeth and cleaning sensory organs.
Report body injuries, discomforts, or inappropriate touches to a trusted adult instantly.

sub_strands.name: Creative Expressions
performance_indicators: Create custom artwork mixing paints and secondary colors using finger-painting techniques.
Construct basic structural items using clean, non-toxic recyclable materials.

sub_strands.name: Pattern Printing
performance_indicators: Produce structured repetitive blocks using stamps, sponge cut-outs, or leaf impressions.

sub_strands.name: Performance and Rhythm
performance_indicators: Perform structural action songs keeping up with variations in pitch and tempo.
Play simple classroom percussion instruments (shakers, drums, triangles) in a group sequence.
Execute expressive body movements matching distinct audio soundscapes.

sub_strands.name: Gross Motor Coordination
performance_indicators: Demonstrate balanced running, hopping on one foot, and skipping mechanics.
Throw, catch, and kick a soft play ball toward an explicitly targeted direction.

sub_strands.name: God the Creator
performance_indicators: Appreciate themselves as unique creations made in the image of God.
Recite simple prayers expressing gratitude for family, protection, and provision.

sub_strands.name: The Life of Jesus Christ
performance_indicators: Listen to and retell foundational stories about the birth and childhood of Jesus.
Emulate values modeled by Jesus such as loving, assisting, and respecting others.

sub_strands.name: Pillars of Iman and Islam
performance_indicators: Recite the Kalimah Shahadah correctly with its translation.
Identify Allah as the sole Creator and Provider of humanity.

sub_strands.name: Islamic Manners and Surahs
performance_indicators: Recite short Surahs from the Qur'an such as Al-Fatiha and Al-Ikhlas.
Utilize standard Islamic phrases like 'Bismillah' before tasks and 'Alhamdulillah' after tasks.

sub_strands.name: Moral Foundations
performance_indicators: Demonstrate empathy, patience, and a sharing attitude during competitive peer interactions.
Practice telling the absolute truth and taking responsibility for minor mistakes.
Internalize positive behavior patterns through systematic institutional mentorship.
